sentences.en: At the foot of the hill is a beautiful lake.
sentences.zh: 山脚下有一个美丽的湖。

sentences.en: If you were footing the bill, you wouldn't say that.
sentences.zh: 如果你买单的话，你不会这么说。

sentences.en: Those children were covered with dirt from head to foot.
sentences.zh: 那些孩子从头到脚都脏兮兮的。
